text:
Kara V: quick idea dump 1 - can we have a tiny sidecar that only performs emergency evictions of a canary variant when local infra signals are awful, but which can never promote a variant?
Miguel R: +1 for local fast path. main constraint: sidecar must be strictly restrictive (evict-only) and use signed policy blobs from CP.
Nina P: agree. signals: p99 latency, 5xx rate, token-timeouts. async quality signals only mark a degradation tag, never trigger an immediate eviction.
Kara V: sidecar modes: passive (log), alert-only (emit intended evict), and evict (actually change routing to fallback). default rollout passive.
Miguel R: sketch policy blob fields:
```
policy_id: pol-2026-03-23-evict01
issued_at: 1830009600
expires_at: 1830096000
allowed_actions: [evict]
allowed_fallbacks: [model-stable-1, model-legacy]
cohorts: [beta, enterprise]
max_evictions_per_window: 3
signature_kid: cp-01
```
Nina P: revocation path: CP pushes a revoke via fanout; sidecars poll a compact PRL every 5s as a fallback. if PRL contains policy_id -> sidecar refuses to act.
Kara V: flip-flop protection: require condition to hold for 3 consecutive 10s windows before eviction; after eviction, cooldown 120s and decrement sensitivity.
Miguel R: KV warmup: eviction can cause cold KV hits. sidecar should emit fallback_cost_est and we should treat that as expected transient. prefer documenting and alerting rather than sync-warm.
Nina P: security: CP signs blobs with HSM-backed key; sidecar verifies kid/thumbprint before applying. rotate keys weekly.
Kara V: observability: emit sidecar.policy_id, sidecar.mode, sidecar.eviction_count, sidecar.eviction_reason, sidecar.reconcile_latency. traces include policy_id and decision_version.
Miguel R: ops runbook (brief):
- passive: sidecar logs to /observability/evict/passive
- alert-only: sidecar posts intended evict to CP and #oncall channel, no routing changes
- evict: sidecar applies guardrailed fallback and posts compact audit event to CP
- if eviction_count > 3 in 10m -> sidecar flips to passive and opens incident
AgentBot: policy_push: pol-2026-03-23-evict01 pushed to 10/10 sidecars at 1830010005
Nina P: testing: add chaos tests that drop push messages and assert PRL reconciliation heals stale policies. add dry-run revoke mode for drills.
Kara V: UX: expose a single "takedown" button that pushes a revoke + opens incident. prefer atomicity.
DeployBot: sidecar-evict v0.1 passive started on router-canary-5 at 1830010015 by miguel
Miguel R: i'll prototype passive + alert-only by EOD Thurs. Nina, can you spec the PRL format?
Nina P: on it. will include compact base64 arrays of revoked ids + issued_at.
Kara V: thanks team :thumbsup: keeps CP authority while giving us a fast, auditable safety net.
